net_interest_income.label: net interest income growth drivers
net_interest_income.description: Management explanation of changes in interest revenue less interest expense, lending volumes, asset yields and cost of funding. The amount of income is different from its margin percentage.

deposit_margin.label: deposit margin competitive pricing and deposit mix
deposit_margin.description: Management commentary about competition for deposits, interest rates offered on transaction savings and term accounts, and how the mix of customer funding affects deposit margins and net interest margin.

personnel.label: staff personnel employee expenses growth
personnel.description: Management discussion of payroll, salaries, wage inflation, headcount, staffing levels, employee costs and the reasons for changes in personnel expenses.

technology.label: technology information technology services expenses growth
technology.description: Management discussion of IT operating costs, software licensing, cloud computing, amortisation, systems investment and technology expense movements.
